title: The Ferry Crossing
description: After years of highway commutes, a tollbooth worker takes a job on a quiet river ferry and finds peace in the crossing.
character_reference: a weathered woman with short graying hair, wearing a navy blue wool captain coat and a warm knitted scarf

scenes.narration: Headlights blurred past my tollbooth window every night in a rush of exhaust fumes and endless highway noise.
scenes.visual: blurs of red and white car taillights streaming past a glowing highway tollbooth in the dark rain

scenes.narration: I traded the concrete asphalt for the steady churn of a diesel engine on a small river ferryboat.
scenes.visual: stepping aboard the wooden deck of a green river ferry while dark water laps gently against the hull

scenes.narration: Steering the heavy vessel across the wide river required feeling the currents rather than fighting against them.
scenes.visual: hands gripping a large wooden ship steering wheel inside a cozy wooden wheelhouse overlooking the water

scenes.narration: Morning fog wrapped around the hull, turning every crossing into a silent voyage through a dreamy white canvas.
scenes.visual: thick white river fog surrounding the bow of a moving ferry cutting through calm gray water

scenes.narration: Passengers sat quietly on the wooden benches, reading books or simply watching the water ripple away.
scenes.visual: passengers sitting quietly on outdoor wooden benches of a ferry wrapped in coats while looking at the river

scenes.narration: Life is not about how fast you arrive at the destination, but how gently you navigate the middle.
scenes.visual: looking out a wheelhouse window at a sparkling river reflecting the orange light of a rising sun

scenes.narration: Find your own smooth water in a turbulent world. Follow along for more stories of mindful transitions.
scenes.visual: wide shot of a small ferry crossing a calm river under a breathtaking pastel sunrise sky
